notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
[h1]New Skill: "Stun and Done"[/h1]

I removed the useless "Prayer" Skill from the center of the skilltree. "Faith Healing" is now the first skill of the skilltree. In place of "Faith Healing" you can now find the new skill "Stun and Done", which enables you to do extra damage to stunned or rooted enemies.

[h1]Bugfixes and Changes[/h1]

- Improved some of the Skill menu UI
- Removed Ingredient buttons from Inventory as this was confusing, you can now only craft by dragging (or pressing A, if you play with a gamepad)
- Changed some faulty translations in the english language file
- Fixed a bug where you could get unlimited XP from outlooks
- Fixed some collision bugs

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
- the first tab in the quickbar now always shows all items

- minor bugfixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]CHALLENGE RUNS[/b]
- added Icons to the escape menu, showing you which special runs you can complete
-> for example: Shows you if you have killed an enemy yet
-> if you have some of these icons at the end of the game, you will get the according achievements
- also fixed some achievement lifehacks

- various minor bugfixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
- fixed a bug where you could get stuck and needed a dodge roll to break free
- made items in the weapon wheel selectable with left click
- slightly changed dashing and rolling mechanic
- made questpanel automatically open when receiving a new main quest
- more minor bugfixes
